classification.rationale: The source uses the Pac-12 Health Analytics Program/CARE-Affiliated Program, a conference-specific registry across 12 Pac-12 institutions. It is not U.S. High School RIO, the NCAA Injury Surveillance Program, or national U.S. surveillance. The paper explicitly distinguishes its Pac-12 athlete-year analysis from prior NCAA athlete-exposure studies, and it reports a clean women's soccer subgroup.

papers.note: Batch 017 S2284 user-approved american_data reclassification and manual primary-PDF extraction. The Pac-12 Health Analytics Program/CARE-Affiliated Program is a conference-specific registry, not U.S. High School RIO, the NCAA Injury Surveillance Program, or national U.S. surveillance. The paper explicitly contrasts its Pac-12 athlete-year analysis with prior NCAA athlete-exposure studies. Only the clean women's soccer subgroup is extracted. Methods and all Results, Tables 1-2, the contact-level Figure, Discussion, limitations, and references were scanned. Table 1 directly reports 182 soccer concussions overall and 34/36/39/17/40/16 by academic season; Table 2 directly reports the matching overall and annual incidences per 100 athlete-years with 95% CIs. No soccer athlete-year total was printed, so exposure was not back-calculated from count/rate; the printed 14,486 athlete-years and 815 unique athletes are all-sport totals and were not copied. Soccer had more than 5 represented teams, but the exact number and soccer-specific player count/age were not reported. The contact-class figure is pooled across sports and was not mapped. Soccer-specific illness, severity, recurrence, mechanism, location, burden, match/training, and time-loss metrics were absent; the authors state that mechanism was not directly assessed.

studyDetails.title: Beyond Contact: Epidemiology of Concussion Incidence in Women's Collegiate Sports, 2016–2022

definitions.injuryDefinition: medical attention [concussion diagnosed by team medical personnel using the Concussion in Sport Group definition]
definitions.incidenceDefinition: concussions per 100 athlete-years (roster-based; each athlete contributes 1 athlete-year per season)
